spacers.finding: No retained reflowed SMT spacer reaches 11.1 mm or more, and every retained SMT spacer needs a land larger than 4 x 4 mm. The one observed tall SMT part (WA-SMSI 12.5 mm, M2.5) is unretained and gives one height only. ST-04 should plan on mechanically fixed posts, which keeps the no-solder-in-load-path rule without an exception.
